commitResults.messageBody:
Alfred.main handles presentation, command routing, parsing, and task
updates in one deeply nested method. This makes the control flow hard to
scan and causes the mark and unmark paths to duplicate validation logic.

Extract focused helpers for lifecycle output, routing, task listing, and
status updates. Centralize the shared mark and unmark validation so each
method operates at one level of abstraction while preserving UI behavior.

Add a scripted mark and unmark acceptance case to guard the consolidated
path against regressions.
